verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents creating datasets and running the application on a dataset to create an experiment. It also offers Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs and an official MCP server, so an agent-driven workflow is plausible. However, the evidence never explicitly shows datasets being created or experiments triggered through the SDK, API or MCP, and the SDK mention is framed around tracing. Missing for 10: explicit docs for programmatic or agent-driven dataset creation, a documented API/SDK/MCP call to launch an eval run, programmatic retrieval of experiment results, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create a dataset, trigger an eval run programmatically, and read back the results

citations.quote: Create a dataset with examples from manually curated test cases, historical production traces, or synthetic data generation.
Execute your application on the dataset to create an experiment.
integrate LangSmith with any agent stack using our Python, Typescript, Go, or Java SDKs
